page.overview:
Who is John Adams?

was the 2nd President of the United States after being the first Vice President for George Washington.

Despite it being a snow day, Bart is cramming for his big test on Colonial American history. He starts to daydream he is in Philadelphia at Independence Hall on July 4, 1776 as Thomas Jefferson reads aloud from the Declaration of Independence to the assembled delegates. It is a very bored John Adams who first noticed it is snowing outside and everyone rushes out to have fun leaving behind just Bart.

Milhouse gets suspended from school for a prank, but takes all the blame so Bart promised to visit him each day, but Bart then shirks it off. Milhouse has come to confront him about it. Bart tells him, "Milhouse, real best friends often don't speak for years at a time, like John Adams and Thomas Jefferson." and Milhouse responses, "Just because you saw one episode of |one miniseries doesn't mean you get to use it as a whip."

Krusty is being pithed by HBOWTIME (a reference to HBO and SHOWTIME) to do a nostalgic reboot. Promo clips of HBOWTIME's prestige TV programming include a miniseries on John Adams (which the real HBO did have one starring Paul Giamatti as John Adams).
